notes: Mapped from a different clean transfer-money call. Transcripts use the Harper Valley human_transcript field verbatim. The one submitted agent form is represented on each step that collected a logged value.

steps.step_description: State the bank name and your own name, then ask how you can help.

agent_turns.transcript: hello this is harper valley national bank my name is michael
how can i help you today

model_example.caller_reply: hi my name is jennifer brown i would like to transfer money between my accounts

steps.step_description: Ask how much the caller wants to transfer.

agent_turns.transcript: okay uhm what is the transfer amount

model_example.caller_reply: the amount is one hundred and forty six dollars

steps.step_description: Ask which account the money comes from (checking or savings).

agent_turns.transcript: and what is the source account

steps.step_description: Ask which account the money goes to (checking or savings).

agent_turns.transcript: okay and what is the destination account

steps.step_description: Submit the transfer, then read back amount, source and destination to confirm it is done.

agent_turns.transcript: alright i have <unk> one hundred and forty six dollars has been transferred from your checking account to your savings account

steps.step_description: Ask whether the caller needs anything else.

agent_turns.transcript: is there anything else i can help you with

model_example.caller_reply: no that's all i needed help with today thank you so much for your help

steps.step_description: Thank the caller and end the call.

agent_turns.transcript: thank you for calling have a great day
